facts.quote: Employee ID 8742 held an active DOE Secret clearance as of 15 Jan 2025, with no suspensions recorded through the alleged incident period.
The employee disclosed having micro‑dosed LSD six times between January 2025 and January 2026, purchased the substance on one occasion, and used it while holding an active clearance.
